headline: Draft Stone Wall Ordinance, proposed federal historic review changes, and a possible Kingston Free Library listing on The Liberty Trail.
summary: The meeting covers proposed changes to federal historic preservation rules and Senate Bill 5653. It also covers a draft Stone Wall Ordinance and a possible application to place the Kingston Free Library on The Liberty Trail.

plain_text:
Posted on 10/29/2026 
 
TOWN OF SOUTH KINGSTOWN 
Historic District Commission 
Meeting Agenda 
Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 6:30 PM 
South Kingstown Town Hall, 2nd Floor Conference Room 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Murray Gates, Chair 
Sharon Henderson, Vice Chair 
John Desmond, Secretary 
Richard Youngken 
Bettina Monaco 
Elle Moore 
- Vacant - 
 
Unless otherwise noted, the HDC may discuss and/or act upon each item on this agenda. 
  
A. Call to Order & Roll Call 
 
B. Approval of Minutes: 
 
 1. 9/24/2026 Draft Minutes 
 
C. Correspondence & Public Comment: 
 
D. New Business: 
 
 1. Section 106 ACHP & Congressional Regulatory Overhauls — Review and discussion of the 
proposed changes by the Advisory Council on Historic Preservation to 36 CFR Part 800 as well as 
Senate Bill 5653. 
 
 2. Kingston Free Library and The Liberty Trail — Discussion of a potential application to place the 
Kingston Free Library on The Liberty Trail, a program of the American Battlefield Trust.  
 
E. Old Business: 
 
 1. Public Workshop on Certificates of Appropriateness and Historic Zoning in South Kingstown — 
Discussion of a potential community engagement event / series of events to inform Town residents 
about historic zoning, the HDC and its regulations, and the certificate of appropriateness process in 
South Kingstown with potential collaboration with South County History Center. 
 
 2. South Kingstown Stone Wall Ordinance — Review of the draft Stone Wall Ordinance and potential 
recommendation to the Planning Board for further review. 
 
 3. Stone Wall Guide and Informational Materials — Discussion of a potential stone wall guidebook 
and/or informational handout to accompany the Stone Wall Ordinance. 
 
 4. Historic Cement Street Markers — Discussion on historic cement street markers in South 
Kingstown, including the 1936 Tercentenary markers, and potential action to promote their 
preservation. 
 
 5. Public Workshop on National Register Listing — Discussion of a potential seminar / workshop 
guiding residents on how to navigate the State and National Register listing process. 
 
F. Staff Update & Planning Department Activities:
Posted on 10/29/2026 
 1. Status of GIS Mapping of Historic Landmarks / Sites 
 
G. Recurring Discussion Topics: 
 
 1. Revisions to the Kingston Historic District Preservation Guidelines 
 
 2. US 250th Celebration Updates 
 
 3. Main Street RI Update 
 
 4. Status of the Application to Place the West Kingston Signal Towner on the National Register of 
Historic Places 
 
 5. Matunuck Beach Historic Resource Survey 
 
 6. Coordination with the Affordable Housing Collaborative Committee 
 
H. New Discussion Issues & Future Agenda Items: 
 
 1. Election of Officers — Discussion of next year's election of officers given pending changes to the 
Commission.  
 
I. Adjournment:
